prose: Adam Butler, author of Butler's DMT Field Guide, joins InnerVerse to talk about how the most powerful (and natural) of psychedelics was part of his path of transformation from living with a stressed out deathwish to experiencing the wonder of life with awestruck gratitude. We discuss what DMT does endogenously in the body, what the blast off, hyperspace beings, and cosmic consciousness are like, the eternal question of "who am I?" and much more.
ext: The trip reports and enlightened speculations continue.
